CAST with CHARACTER SET fails to parse correctly

#### Description

When parsing CAST expressions with CHARACTER SET clauses, the parser fails to handle the CHARACTER SET portion properly, causing parsing errors or incorrect AST generation.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import sqlglot

# This should parse correctly but fails
sql = "CAST(x AS CHAR CHARACTER SET latin1)"
parsed = sqlglot.parse_one(sql)
print(parsed)

# Also fails with binary character set
sql2 = "SELECT CAST(COALESCE(`id`, 'NULL') AS CHAR CHARACTER SET binary)"
parsed2 = sqlglot.parse_one(sql2)
print(parsed2)
```

The parser should be able to handle CAST expressions that include CHARACTER SET specifications, which are valid MySQL syntax for specifying the character encoding of the cast result.
</issue>
